prompt: A person faces you in anatomical position. Select every valid relationship.

options.text: Their right is on your left.
options.explanation: Right and left name the subject’s sides. Facing the subject reverses their position on your visual field.

options.text: The wrist is distal to the elbow.
options.explanation: Distal describes distance along the limb away from its attachment; the wrist is farther along than the elbow.

options.text: Anterior means whichever surface faces the observer.
options.explanation: Anterior is anchored to anatomical position. Moving the observer does not rename a body surface.

mechanism: Anatomical directions retain a shared reference when the observer or limb position changes.

prompt: After one complete round of semiconservative replication, each daughter DNA duplex contains one parental strand and one newly synthesised strand. Is this statement true?

options.explanation: Each separated parental strand serves as a template for a complementary new strand.
Keeping both parental strands together would describe the conservative model, not the semiconservative model taught here.

mechanism: Complementary base pairing allows each parental strand to template a partner while preserving one parental strand in each daughter duplex.

prompt: Name the H&E stain associated with blue-purple staining of nucleic-acid-rich structures. Give the stain name, rather than inferring an organ.
model: Haematoxylin (hematoxylin). Its mordant complex highlights many nucleic-acid-rich structures; stain colour alone does not identify an organ.
mechanism: Staining provides contrast. Tissue identification still requires architecture, cell arrangement and matrix, not nuclear colour alone.

prompt: In a hypothetical clearance calculation, urine concentration U = 100 mg/mL, urine flow V = 1 mL/min and plasma concentration P = 1 mg/mL. Calculate C = U × V / P. This is a calculation exercise, not a GFR measurement unless the marker’s handling justifies that interpretation.
precision: Report to the nearest 1 mL/min (or equivalent L/min). Select the unit. Allowed rounding difference: 0.5 mL/min.
workedSolution: C = U × V / P. U is urine concentration, V is urine volume per time, and P is plasma concentration.
mechanism: Clearance divides the excreted amount per time by the plasma concentration, giving a virtual volume per time. It does not measure a volume of plasma physically removed.
